title: JSON aggregate value and final wrappers

scope.rationale: The built-in registry's json_group_array and json_group_object window/aggregate callbacks use distinct source-shaped xValue and xFinal wrappers over their shared compute owners.
excluded_responsibilities: JSON aggregate step, inverse, and compute bodies

dependencies.caller_closure: Canonical built-in registrations reference all four wrappers for aggregate final and window value callbacks.

inputs: SQLite function context retaining JSON aggregate state
outputs: Transient value snapshot or ownership-ending final result
contracts.ownership: xValue preserves the aggregate buffer; xFinal deinitializes it after publishing the result.
contracts.state_and_results: Array wrappers dispatch to array compute and object wrappers to object compute with exact final flags.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks or I/O; callback dispatch only.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Compute owner publishes OOM and empty-group results; xValue permits continuation and xFinal ends ownership.

representation_differences: Typed Zig callbacks directly call a shared boolean-final compute owner rather than C static wrappers.

oracle.protocol: Invoke aggregate final callbacks through prepared scalar aggregate SQL and invoke value callbacks through maintained callback-level tests; compare JSON text, subtype, continuation, and cleanup.
internal_observations: final flag and retained aggregate buffer
oracle.normalization: Compare exact JSON bytes and callback continuation state.

assurance.oom: Shared compute owner publishes OOM and preserves callback safety.
assurance.malformed_input: The wrappers accept source-valid aggregate contexts; empty state is handled by compute.
assurance.continuation: xValue trims the appended close delimiter; xFinal releases the owner.

integration.native_call_path: prepared aggregate/window callback dispatch -> value/final wrapper -> shared compute

independent_review.notes: Prepared window-frame integration, trace, and review remain open.

known_blockers: Complete prepared JSON window-value integration and independent review.

implementation_spans: Complete source wrappers and surrounding compute owners
assertions_branches_cleanup: empty aggregate, value continuation, final ownership, OOM, text subtype reviewed
upstream_tests: Project prepared JSON aggregate tests and internal JSON callback tests
